posts.title: Where the Bottleneck Goes When AI-SQL Calls a Model Millions of Times - Quail, Query Plans That Control Inference, and the Conditions Behind Its Numbers
posts.description: Quail plans SQL and LLM inference together. Qwen3 4B FP8, one H100, vs vLLM: 1.84x geomean at scale factor 0.1, 14.04x on BIO-4 at 1.0, and why AGENT-1 loses.

posts.title: The Scheduler Never Disappears, It Only Moves - What Follows from Async Rust Keeping Its Runtime in a Crate
posts.description: An essay argues that needing a runtime is a general concurrency issue, not an async Rust flaw. Kernel, language runtime, crate or parameter: what each costs.

posts.title: What Code Leaned On in the Example Domain's Response Body - What Changed on example.com and What No Standard Ever Guaranteed
posts.description: example.com became a six-language page on September 28, 2026 and lost its animation on October 3. The 577-byte HTML, IANA guidance and RFC text compared.

posts.title: How to Read a Claim of Training Without Backpropagation - What Dust Perturbs, How It Gets Its Signal, and the Scale It Was Compared At
posts.description: Dust from Q Labs pretrains transformers with per-token activation noise and no backward pass: model size, token budgets, loss gap to backprop, stated limits.

posts.title: Read Survey Numbers With Their Denominators - What State of Devs 2026 Asked, Who Answered, and How Far the Results Reach
posts.description: State of Devs 2026 is a self-selected Devographics survey of 5,463 people. Burnout, layoffs and AI sentiment reread with question wording and denominators.

posts.title: What Mathematics Must Redefine When Solving and Understanding Come Apart - Jeremy Avigad's Guest Post on Tao's Blog
posts.description: Jeremy Avigad's guest post on Terence Tao's blog, read in order: how solving and understanding decouple, his three answers, and the hedges summaries drop.

posts.title: What Changes When a Compiler Targets an Intermediate Representation Instead of Source Text - Gleam v1.19.0 and Erlang Abstract Forms
posts.description: Gleam v1.19.0 stops emitting Erlang source and generates Erlang abstract forms instead. What changes in the pipeline, build time and stack trace lines.

posts.title: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics and the IceCube Neutrino Observatory - What the Two Phrases of the Citation Point To and What Is Still Open
posts.description: Francis Halzen alone won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for IceCube and high-energy cosmic neutrinos. The citation is read against the official texts.

posts.title: null and a Missing Key Are Different States - Why a PATCH Erases Values
posts.description: null and a missing key are different JSON states, yet get-style reads merge them and a PATCH erases values. RFC 7396 and live runs show the safe patterns.

posts.title: Making ^ and $ Apply to Each Line - What the Multiline Flag Actually Changes and Where $ Misses on CRLF
posts.description: The multiline flag only makes ^ and $ recognize line boundaries. Python, Node, .NET, Perl and grep output on LF and CRLF input shows how $, \A and \z differ.
